name: M3_CRS610MI_ChgOrderInfo
description: Update order-related defaults and controls on an existing customer record. This operation maintains the data that M3 uses as default values when creating customer orders, such as order type, pricing and discount behavior, warehouse and logistics settings, invoicing options, and statistical groupings. The maintained fields correspond mainly to the F and G panels in Customer master (CRS610) and do not change basic identity or financial terms for the customer. Use this operation to keep the customer’s order-handling setup aligned with current commercial agreements and logistics flows so that new orders are created with correct defaults.
